title: Home practical guide and safety card: dissolving test
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lessons 29, 30 (Home practical guide and safety card: dissolving test (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 29: Do all solids dissolve?. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which materials dissolve in water
equipment: Materials: salt, sugar, sand, flour, coffee granules
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Pour the same amount of water into each cup
Add one teaspoon of one material to each cup
Stir each the same number of times (ten stirs)
Look closely: can you still see the solid?
Leave for two minutes and look again
Sort: dissolves or does not dissolve

questions.q: A clear mixture made by dissolving is a...
Big question: has dissolved sugar really gone?
questions.a: No: it is in tiny pieces in the water and can be got back by evaporating.
